name: Come Back Strong
source: ported from js/data/sessions.js — the program Sevan is actually on

constraints.knee: no running, no jumping, no deep knee flexion under load

goals: Show up three times a week

habits.label: Sport session
habits.note: weekly — tick it on the day you do it

blocks.name: Warm-up A · Loosen up
blocks.note: Never rushed, but no stopping — flow straight through. This is the part that protects the joints.

blocks.name: Warm-up A · Circuit
blocks.note: 3 rounds, continuous — no rest inside a round

items.note: Hands under your shoulders, body in one straight line.
Just hang from the bar with straight arms and let your shoulders stretch out.
Band in both hands, arms straight out in front.
Push-up position.

blocks.name: A · Push-Ups + Lat Pulldown
blocks.note: A1 straight into A2 with no rest, then rest 75 sec, then go again.

items.note: Straight Bar Push-Up · superset A1 · Set a bar in the rack about waist height.
superset A2

blocks.name: B · Assisted Dip + Cable Row
blocks.note: B1 straight into B2 with no rest, then rest 75 sec.

items.note: superset B1
superset B2

blocks.name: C · Lateral Raise + Pushdown
blocks.note: C1 into C2, no rest, then 75 sec.

items.note: superset C1
superset C2

blocks.name: D · Reverse Fly + Curl
blocks.note: D1 into D2, no rest, then 75 sec. Reverse fly is never heavy — light and slow.

items.note: superset D1 · Chest flat on an incline bench, light dumbbells hanging.
superset D2

blocks.name: Finisher · Kettlebell Swings
blocks.note: 3 rounds of 12, rest 20 sec between rounds.

blocks.name: Finisher · Farmer's Carry
blocks.note: 4 rounds · walk 30-40 m · rest 45-60 sec between rounds. No straps — grip is the point. Start 40-50 lb per hand.

items.note: Farmer's Carry · A dumbbell in each hand, no straps.

blocks.name: Warm-up B · Sequence 2
blocks.note: 2 rounds, continuous — no rest inside a round

items.note: Banded Side-Step March · Band around your legs, stay low in a quarter-squat, step sideways without letting your feet click together.
Hands under your shoulders, body in one straight line.
Just hang from the bar with straight arms and let your shoulders stretch out.
Superman · Lie face down, arms stretched out in front, thumbs pointing up.
Push-up position.

blocks.name: Full Body Circuit
blocks.note: Straight through, 3-5 rounds. Rest 90 sec between rounds ONLY — no rest between exercises. One pair of dumbbells: start 25-30 lb per hand (the shoulder press is the limiter). The RDL and row will feel light on purpose for now — that is fine for the first month.

items.note: DB Romanian Deadlift · Push your hips back, slide the dumbbells down the front of your legs, knees almost straight.
Sit or stand tall, dumbbells at shoulder height.
DB Bent-Over Row · Hinge at the hips, flat back, dumbbells hanging.
DB Push-Ups · Hands gripping the two dumbbells on the floor so your wrists stay straight.
Plank Hold · Elbows under your shoulders, body in one straight line.
Wall Sit · Back flat on the wall, slide down until your thighs are somewhere comfortable — the higher you stay, the easier on the knee.

blocks.name: Finisher · Core Circuit
blocks.note: 30 sec each, no rest between exercises. 2-3 rounds, 45 sec between rounds.

items.note: On your back, arms up, knees over hips.
On your side, elbow under your shoulder, knees bent at 90°.
On your side, elbow under your shoulder, knees bent at 90°.
On hands and knees.
Leg Raises · On your back, hands under your hips.
